name: Reproducible nested-LOSO benchmark
description: Reproducible nested-LOSO benchmark This first public release provides the standalone, deterministic reproduction package for the primary classical comparison in the associated GPR land-use-recognition study. Contents canonical processed feature table: 721 files, 121 LocationIDs, 13 survey sites, and five land-use classes; strict nested leave-one-site-out RBF-SVC reproduction code; frozen result tables, selected hyperparameters, and LocationID-level predictions; environment requirements, data provenance, and code/data licence files. Verified reproduction Running python src/run_nested_loso.py --data data/canonical_features.parquet --output outputs reproduces pooled LocationID macro-F1 values of 0.3351 for the content-only representation and 0.3645 for the combined non-size representation. Data provenance The processed release derives from the public 4TU.ResearchData utility-survey GPR archive: https://doi.org/10.4121/96303227-5886-41c9-8607-70fdd2cfe7c1.v1. Raw SEG-Y files are obtained from the upstream archive rather than duplicated here.
